mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ur.region_id AS area_id, ur.region_name AS area_name, r.region_id AS bay_id, r.region_name AS bay_name, IFNULL(i.inspection_code, d.device_id) AS device_id, IFNULL(i.inspection_name, d.device_name) AS device_name, i.component_id, m.custom_name AS component_name, m.meter_type, IFNULL(m.appearance_type, "7") AS appearance_type, IFNULL(i.save_type_list, "2") AS save_type_list, m.mete_type AS recognition_type_list, IFNULL(m.redundant_type, "2") AS point_type, IFNULL(i.photo_num, "0") AS photo_num, i.phase, m.label_attri, d.device_id AS main_device_id, d.device_name AS main_device_name, da.voltage_level, d.device_type, "2" AS data_type, CONCAT(da.longitude, ';', da.latitude) AS master_coordinate, d.device_id master_point_id, "0" AS Args FROM t_std_device d LEFT JOIN t_std_device_attr da ON d.device_id = da.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region r ON d.up_region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region ur ON r.up_region_id = ur.region_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection i ON i.main_device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete m ON m.device_id = i.main_device_id WHERE ur.region_id = #{regionId} and d.position_type = 'simple' ORDER BY d.device_id
